definitions.gloss: underworld; criminal quarter; world of organized crime
definitions.explanation: The world of organized crime, or a district known for criminal activity. Often used in fiction, film, and journalism.

examples.japanese: {暗黒街|あんこくがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ボス→ボス：11269_bosu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暗黒街|あんこくがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧にした⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧だ。
examples.english: This film is a story set in the criminal underworld.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{混乱期|こんらんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{暗黒街|あんこくがい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勢力|せいりょく}→勢力：11812_seiryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The criminal underworld expanded its influence during the postwar period of chaos.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{暗黒|あんこく}→暗黒：12997_ankoku⟧ (darkness) and {街|がい} (district/quarter). Evokes the image of a shadowy, lawless world. Frequently used in film noir, detective fiction, and crime dramas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暗黒街|あんこくがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ボス→ボス：11269_bosu⟧: underworld boss
- {暗黒街|あんこくがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支配|しはい}する→支配する：25222_shihaisuru⟧: to rule the underworld
- {暗黒街|あんこくがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{入|い}れる: to step into the underworld

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裏社会|うらしゃかい}→裏社会：26945_urashakai⟧: underworld, shadow society — more commonly used in modern Japanese for the criminal world
- ⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧: darkness — metaphorically used for illegal or hidden activities (⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧⟦ルート→ルート：11250_ruuto⟧, ⟦{闇取引|やみとりひき}→闇取引：18918_yamitorihiki⟧)
- マフィア: mafia — specifically refers to organized crime syndicates
